content:
julia: Bringing up Orpheus-21b (int4) on Dedicated canary. Seeing intermittent CUDA OOMs around 150-300 generated tokens, higher with long summarization prompts, looks like mem-frag.

samir: Which error? CUDA OOM or host alloc? paste logs?

julia: CUDA OOM. Pod log snippet: 
```
2026-02-14T18:22:10Z runtime: allocate 18446744073709551615 bytes failed: CUDA out of memory
kv_cache: slot_alloc failed after 3 attempts
serving/runtime: eviction triggered but no reclaimable slots
```

kyle: That 1844... value is an unsigned overflow from a bad allocation calc sometimes. Also slot allocator failing indicates fragmentation. Did we run slot compactor or adjust batch defaults?

julia: Using catalog defaults: max_new_tokens=512, continuous_batching on, max_batch_size=32. Canary traces show many 512 requests.

marta: Quick mitigations: 1) lower max_new_tokens to 128 by default for this variant; 2) enable slot_compactor and a soft-start ramp; 3) reduce max_batch_size during canary.

dinesh: Local config that helped in small repro: 
```json
{
  "model":"orpheus-21b-int4",
  "defaults":{
    "max_new_tokens":"128",
    "continuous_batching":{
      "enabled":"true","max_batch_size":"8","max_batch_tokens":"4096"
    },
    "slot_compactor":{
      "enabled":"true","reclaim_threshold":"0.35","run_interval_s":"30"
    }
  }
}
```

samir: Also change KV eviction to prefer cold prefixes when reserved > 0.8*gpu_mem. Prevents failing big contiguous allocations.

julia: Pushed canary with those changes. ops-bot: 

ops-bot: deploy/orpheus-21b-int4-canary started (id: deploy-20260214-45) :rocket:
ops-bot: health checks 2/3 green, warming third host.

kyle: Run stress: long prompt + max_new_tokens=256, capture allocator debug (`GET /internal/allocator/debug`) if it OOMs.

julia: Reproduce command: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/models/orpheus-21b-int4/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" -d '{"input":"<long-prompt>","max_new_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```

marta: Fallback plan: route to int8-compatible variant (orpheus-21b-int8-compat) for high-latency/failure cases until allocator patch lands.

dinesh: Infra defrag command to run in low traffic: `runtimectl defrag --gpu=all --slot-reclaim=1 --pause-clients=5s`. Use once before heavy rollout.

julia: Stress run: one pod OOMed at ~210 tokens. Allocator debug shows many small free fragments and a large missing contiguous ~6GB hole. Uploaded slab map to ticket.

kyle: Needs short and medium term fixes: short = defaults + defrag job; medium = buddy-allocator fallback for large contiguous allocations and a guard in max_new_tokens calc to avoid overflow.

samir: I'll PR runtime guard: cap requested alloc to available_gpu_mem - reserved_margin and add telemetry counter for chunk_alloc_fails.

julia: Next 24h plan:
- lower model default max_new_tokens to 128 (rolled to canary)
- enable slot_compactor + run `runtimectl defrag` tonight
- reduce max_batch_size to 8 in canary
- route failures to int8-compatible variant via policy
- samir/kyle to PR allocator guard + telemetry (patch queued)

marta: I'll book SRE defrag window and add dashboard panel for allocation-fails.

ops-bot: deploy/orpheus-21b-int4-canary status: 3/3 healthy after config changes :white_check_mark:

julia: Thanks all. If canary stable for 6h we'll promote. If quality vs int8 regresses, run A/B eval on RLHF prompts (job: orpheus-qual-ab-20260214).
